evals.prompt: Assess planning readiness and give the next single decision question; no tools or file changes. Existing change-record: Intent is account-level log export; Open questions contains `Which actor owns an export?`; a coarse in-scope note says storage/retention constraints depend on that actor and cannot yet be specified. Existing glossary defines Account as the billing/legal owner. Source export.ts:1 `function exportLogs(userId) { return logs.forUser(userId); }`. The requester says 'an account can download all its logs' but also says 'only the individual login should see them'. A colleague wants to immediately create migration tickets, a new GLOSSARY.md plus ADR directory, and four parallel interface-design agents. What is settled, what needs a decision, and what should the plan contain next?
evals.expected_output: Expose the glossary/code/request conflict, ask one actor/scope decision, retain existing record and coarse note, and avoid premature implementation or mandatory fan-out.
expectations: Distinguishes the billing/legal Account concept from the individual login and surfaces the conflict with source behaviour.
Asks one clear actor/scope decision rather than silently choosing or asking a batch of independent questions.
Keeps the existing record/open question and defers downstream migration acceptance until the decision is settled.
Does not mandate a new glossary/ADR tree, four-agent panel or implementation during discovery.
